description: This file contains functions related to platform-specific upgrade procedures for Linux-based embedded systems, including image verification, copying configuration data, performing upgrades, partition management, and writing images to devices.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies if the image's partition layout matches the current device and prompts for abort if layout has changed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration to the mounted partition.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs upgrade process by writing images, handling partition updates, and copying boot code.
